_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (war-camps, fortresses, and drill-yards)

branch.regression: clipped barked commands (orc-guttural but ORDERED and geminated; hard doubled stops, sharp clipped finals -rok/-thar/-kk, little growl-drawl)
branch.nature: disciplined martial goblinoids; the LEAST-rotted, most drill-like Kazhur; soldiers and conquerors
branch.model: Kazhur rotted least of all - kept hard and ordered for command

_note: Beastman culture: HOBGOBLINS, disciplined martial goblinoids - the LEAST-rotted Kazhur, kept hard, clipped, and ordered for barked command (qatal 'kill' -> Qattar-rok). A chaotic MOCKERY of order: tyrant-discipline, legions, the lash. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Iron Order / the War-Banner Beast). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Hobgoblin (Kazhur, clipped-command regression): orc-guttural but ORDERED - hard geminated stops (-kk/-tt), sharp clipped finals -rok/-thar/-tark, minimal growl-drawl; barked, drill-like. The least-rotted beastman tongue.
phonology.phonotactics: tight CVC/CVCC with geminate codas; sharp clipped stress; commanding.

morphology.naming_marker: named by rank and the kashtar at a blooding; a hard rank-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief (commander) of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord (Iron Overlord) over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / legion-host - the most ordered of beastmen (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-commander of a frontier / raiding clanhold

county.scope: high commander over a few clanholds

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic - a chaotic MOCKERY of order. Race-totem the Iron Order / the War-Banner Beast. The Kashtar serves the war-totem and, foremost, Gul-Maraqus the great War-Spirit (hobgoblins are the war-race); the One and - tellingly - Orlanu the Chainer (Lawful order) are demonized: their discipline serves Chaos, not Law.
religion.race_totem: the War-Banner Beast (Milkkar-behtark) / the Iron Order

demonized.Orlandus (Lawful order, the oath): Orlanu the Chainer (true order, which their tyranny mocks)

religion.shaman_rites: war-rites at the standard and the skull-helm; the drilling of the host before the totem; blood on the banner.

holy_symbol_motifs.War-Banner Beast: a fanged beast on an iron standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Gul-Maraqus: a notched cleaver crossed with a banner-pole

banks_patterns.war_bands: named legions and companies: 'the Iron Order', 'the Red Standard', 'the Black Spear legion of [warlord]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: war-camps, fortresses, and drill-yards: 'the War-camp of [host]', 'the Fortress of [warlord]', 'the Iron Barracks of [name]'
